14.0.old: and, when the round did not run, the reason. A fault in either node never stops the run.
14.0.new: and, when the round did not run, the reason. A question the checks refuse is recorded DROPPED with the judge's reply whole: the first reply, and the second reply when the judge was asked again (first_reply, second_reply; QR Final). A continuation the checks refuse is recorded DROPPED with the judge's reply whole (reply; QR Follow Final). A question or continuation that passes adds no reply field (ASK 595). A fault in either node never stops the run.

09.0.old: where no layer in that side's block of the MEANS round carries it: an [L2] gloss
09.0.new: where no layer in that side's block of the MEANS round carries it (the block is the line of that round holding the first six words of the MEANS quotation and the lines after it, seven at most, ending before a blank line or a line that begins with a number, MEANS, LINK <n>, or a verse reference and a quotation mark; the block is read whole, ASK 595): an [L2] gloss
